neighbours.label: the last digit or ' billion' right before 'light-years'
fire: The exoplanet is about 340 light-years from Earth.
The nebula lies roughly 1,500 light-years away.
The galaxy is nearly 2 billion light years distant.
The star sits 600 light-years from us.
The quasar is 12 billion light years away.
quiet: The village is about 340 miles from Denver.
The lake lies roughly 1,500 feet away.
The debt is nearly 2 billion dollars.
The farm sits 600 meters from us.

notes: The output direction: the + pole suppresses ' light', ' lights', so this - pole promotes them. Probes with miles and acres reached 0.12-0.16.
